provenance: iManage's published connector documentation (docs.imanage.com MCP server help) and the iManage-published Microsoft connector listing (updated June 2026)
confidence: medium — iManage publishes tool descriptions, not JSON schemas; only container_id and query are verbatim-confirmed parameter names. An authenticated tools/list is the only source of byte-exact schemas.
notes: Document ids use the LIBRARY!number.version grammar (ACTIVE!5482.3). Pagination: 100 per page, 500 results maximum, no caller-chosen page size on search; get_document_versions returns up to 1000. Throttle 100 calls / 60s. iManage ships four connectors (Work, Tracker, Search, Insight+); this is Work.

waived.download_document.chunk: the docs imply chunked retrieval for large files but publish no parameter name; our documents fit one response
waived.get_recent_documents.filters: document-property filters are described but unnamed in the published docs
waived.get_workspace_templates.library_name: emulated: the record has no template store, so a library offers the folder shapes its own matters already have — derived from the record, never invented
